ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominance of low-intensity pixels in the central 60% of the surface area, contrasted with high-intensity mottled regions at the distal 20% of each lobe.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Centrally localized low-intensity mass extending from the peduncle junction. Distal regions exhibit a mottled transition to high-intensity backgrounds containing discrete low-intensity circular islands.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped convergence at center-fluke; internal angle measured at approximately 82 degrees relative to the lobe axes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous series of irregular peaks and troughs along the trailing boundary. Peak-to-trough amplitude varies significantly. Edge frequency is high, with approximately 30-40 distinct serrations per lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edges exhibit a general convex arc from the median notch to the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of approximately 40 discrete low-intensity circular pixel clusters distributed primarily on the distal high-intensity regions of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of 5 distinct, parallel low-intensity linear tracks oriented vertically on the proximal-superior surface of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Evidence of vertical rake marks on the right lobe; jagged, irregular margins at the distal tips suggestive of mechanical wear or minor amputations.
